name: LiveTV Scheduler
description: Simulates live TV programming using your existing Jellyfin media library. Create custom channels, assign shows and movies, and generate automatic schedules. Streams directly from local files with no external dependencies or transcoding overhead.
overview: Create virtual live TV channels from your media library

versions.changelog: Add per-channel Stream Mode setting. On-demand (default) starts each tune-in at the beginning of the current program with correct progress reporting; Live seeks into the program at the scheduled offset using HLS transcoding so it behaves like real broadcast TV.
Initial release with channel management, schedule generation, and native Jellyfin Live TV integration.
